descriptionChirho: To practice divination, soothsaying, or sorcery; includes all Piel inflections: perfect forms describing past practice of divination (2 Kings 21:6, 2 Chronicles 33:6), participle forms denoting the practitioner as diviner/soothsayer/sorceress (masculine singular, feminine singular, masculine plural), and imperfect forms expressing future practice. All share the single semantic domain of illicit prognostication and omen-reading.
